FDE Talent Sourcing & Qualification

4.1 Sourcing channels

Academic: universities, engineering colleges, computer science and IT programmes, AI and data science programmes, final-year students and graduates.

Professional: software engineers, full-stack developers, AI/ML engineers, data engineers, cloud and DevOps professionals, business analysts, product engineers and technology consultants.

Experienced: senior engineers, solution architects, domain specialists, transformation consultants and technical programme leaders.

4.2 Qualification process

  • Technical competency assessment
  • Business and process understanding
  • Analytical and problem-solving ability
  • Architecture and solution thinking
  • Practical case simulation
  • Communication and stakeholder engagement
  • Deployment readiness evaluation

4.3 FormatiQs FDE Talent Registry

A structured talent database should capture professional profile, competency scores, technical specialisations, domain experience, project portfolio, assessment history, certifications, availability, location and deployment preferences, and employment or engagement status. The registry becomes the foundation for matching global client requirements with qualified talent.

FDE Deployment & Engineering Services

5.1 Deployment models

ModelDescriptionTypical use
Individual FDEAn FDE embedded with a client team for a defined business challenge.AI implementation, automation, product engineering and integration.
Dedicated FDE PodA multidisciplinary team deployed for a business outcome.Complex workflows, enterprise AI and product delivery.
Managed FDE TeamFormatiQs manages the dedicated team, delivery governance and quality.Ongoing engineering capacity.
Project-Based DeploymentA defined project from discovery through deployment and adoption.Scoped transformation or engineering initiatives.
Global Hybrid DeploymentOnsite, offshore and remote professionals under common governance.Cross-border delivery and distributed teams.

5.2 Illustrative FDE pod

  • Lead FDE / Solution Architect
  • Business Process Analyst
  • AI / Full-Stack Engineer
  • Data / Integration Engineer
  • QA / Testing Engineer
  • Deployment / DevOps Engineer

Pod composition varies according to the problem, scope, architecture, client environment and required delivery skills.

5.3 Deployment lifecycle

  • Client opportunity identification
  • Business challenge discovery
  • Scope and outcome definition
  • Technical and process architecture
  • Resource and skill planning
  • FDE talent matching
  • Team onboarding and deployment
  • Engineering and integration
  • Testing and quality assurance
  • Production deployment
  • Business adoption and value tracking
  • Ongoing support and optimisation
